WHERE THE MISSING YEAR BOOK YEARS ARE — HATHITRUST, AND THIS ENVIRONMENT CANNOT READ THEM
==========================================================================================

[SUPERSEDED 2026-09-07 IN ITS CONCLUSION, NOT IN ITS FACTS. Everything below about HathiTrust's
holdings and about the Cloudflare wall is still true and still useful. THE TITLE'S SECOND CLAUSE
IS NOT. This environment CAN read the missing years — all of them, including the three
HathiTrust itself lacks — at the University of Minnesota's ContentDM collection p16022coll351,
which is open. The route was sitting inside this very file, in the ROUTES NOT TRIED list, as
"the Kautz Family YMCA Archives, University of Minnesota, WHICH HOLDS THE SERIES IN PRINT" —
where the last clause was an assumption written down as though it were a finding, and it closed
the route off. See 2026-09-07-umedia-the-series-is-readable-after-all.txt and f_5263. Google
Books was retried on 2026-09-07 as this file asks: still 429, and naming the same consumer
project number, so it is a shared key exhausted by other traffic rather than a daily quota that
resets — the "retry on a later day" advice below is wrong and should not be followed again.]
Compiled 2026-09-06 (p_436). This is a finding aid and an ACCESS FAILURE RECORD, not a source of
camp facts. Nothing below has been read.

THE QUESTION
------------
The Internet Archive inventory compiled earlier today (f_4985) established that the YMCA *Year
Book* is unavailable there for 1883, 1885, 1889, 1901-1905, 1910-1920 and 1923-1935 — holes that
survived four separately corrected search methods. 1910-1920 is the costly one: the new site's
first decade, the whole First World War, and the years in which W. J. Holliday either did or did
not recover the Boys' Work directorship he had lost to M. G. Brooks by 1909.

THE ANSWER: HATHITRUST HAS ESSENTIALLY ALL OF THEM, AND THEY ARE PUBLIC DOMAIN
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HathiTrust's Bib API works from here. Its search interface and every reading endpoint do not —
see the access note below. Two catalogue records hold the series, and THEY MUST BOTH BE QUERIED:
the OCLC lookup returns one record and 42 items; the LCCN lookup returns that record AND a second
one (011919824) with eleven further items, including the cleanest run of the 1901-1906 years.

    OCLC 6996715   ->  record 000528855              42 items
    LCCN 29015142  ->  records 000528855 + 011919824  53 items

THE HOLES, AND THE HATHITRUST ITEM ID FOR EACH. All are rightsCode "pd" — public domain, full
view to anyone who can reach the site.

  1901        ien.35556001609783
  1902        ien.35556001609791      (also mdp.39015069277856, and mdp.39015069278029 for 1902-03)
  1903        ien.35556001609809      (also mdp.39015069278011 for 1903-04)
  1904        ien.35556001609817      (also mdp.39015069278003 for 1904-05)
  1905        ien.35556001609825      (also mdp.39015069245861 for 1905-06)
  1909-1910   mdp.39015069245812
  1910-11     uiug.30112109814126
  1911/12     uiug.30112109814233
  1913/14     uiug.30112109814225
  1915/16     uiug.30112109814217
  1916/17     uiug.30112109814209
  1917/18     uiug.30112109814191
  1918/19     uiug.30112086367254
  1919/20     uiug.30112109814183

Also there, and useful as independent second copies of years already held: 1891, 1896, 1897,
1898, 1899, 1906 (the ien. run), 1921 (mdp.39015069245804), 1923/24 and 1924.

STILL MISSING EVEN FROM HATHITRUST, on these two records: 1883, 1885, 1889, and — within the war
decade — 1912/13, 1914/15 and 1920/21. The 1942-1962 volumes are held but are rightsCode "ic",
in copyright and not viewable.

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT SETTLE
----------------------------------
IT SETTLES WHERE THE YEARS ARE. This project had recorded them as unavailable. They are
available, they are public domain, and each one now has an identifier. "Not on the Internet
Archive" was never the same statement as "not digitised", and the distinction was worth the hour.

IT DOES NOT GET THEM READ. See below.


ACCESS FAILURE — RECORDED AS ONE, WITH THE ROUTES NAMED
--------------------------------------------------------
HATHITRUST. The Bib API (catalog.hathitrust.org/api/volumes/...) RETURNS JSON NORMALLY; it was
control-tested against a known OCLC before any of the above was trusted. Everything else returns
HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare interstitial ("Just a moment..."):

    catalog.hathitrust.org/Search/Home            403, 5,810-byte challenge page
    babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/ls (full-text search) 403
    babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt (the reader)       403, 5,534 bytes
    babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/imgsrv/html           403, 66,875 bytes
    babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/imgsrv/download/pdf   403, 66,875 bytes

So this environment can ENUMERATE HathiTrust precisely and READ NOTHING FROM IT. That is a fact
about the gateway, not about the volumes.

GOOGLE BOOKS. Not a null either. The API returned HTTP 429: "Quota exceeded for quota metric
'Queries' and limit 'Queries per day'". The control query failed identically, so this says
nothing about what Google holds. IT IS A DAILY QUOTA AND MAY RESET — retry on a later day before
concluding anything. Worth retrying specifically: the mdp. and uiug. scans are University of
Michigan and University of Illinois copies, both Google-digitised, so Google Books plausibly has
the same volumes.

ROUTES NOT TRIED
  - The HathiTrust Data API, which needs OAuth credentials. A person can request them.
  - ANY PERSON WITH A BROWSER. These volumes are public domain and full-view; the Cloudflare
    challenge is aimed at automation, not at readers. This is a good candidate for a human task:
    the pages wanted are the Quebec branch directory and the Montreal block of the alphabetical
    list of employed officers, which in every volume of this series sit about a quarter and about
    three-quarters of the way in respectively.
  - Google Books on a later day, per the quota above.
  - The Kautz Family YMCA Archives, University of Minnesota, which holds the series in print.

WHAT TO ASK THE VOLUMES WHEN SOMEONE CAN OPEN THEM
--------------------------------------------------
In priority order, because 1910-11 answers the sharpest question:

  1. 1910-11 and 1911/12 — IS W. J. HOLLIDAY BOYS' WORK DIRECTOR AGAIN? He holds that post in the
     1907 and 1908 volumes, is listed as plain "Asst." in 1909 with M. G. BROOKS in the post
     (f_4983), and opens the camp's new site in 1910, which the association's 1910 annual report
     announces without giving him any boys' work title. The answer bears directly on a claim this
     project has already had to withdraw once.
  2. Every volume 1910-1920 — the Montreal Boys' Work Director year by year. The Boys' Department
     ran the camp, so this is the closest thing to a list of the men over Kanawana through the war.
  3. 1901-1905 — the years between W. H. Ball leaving the Physical Directorship (he holds it in
     1900, J. E. Merritt has it by 1906) and Merritt's arrival. Ball's departure is currently
     bounded only to 1901-1905.
  4. M. G. BROOKS in any of them — he is new to this project entirely and held the Boys' Work
     directorship in the year before the new site opened.

QUERIES RUN: catalog.hathitrust.org/api/volumes/full/oclc/6996715.json;
.../full/lccn/29015142.json; a control on .../brief/oclc/1481153.json; the five babel and catalog
endpoints listed above; googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes with a control query. The OCLC and LCCN
themselves came from the Internet Archive metadata of items already held
(ymcayearbookand00assogoog and ymcayearbookoffi00youn both carry lccn 29015142).
